postgres: Separate private C/V clusters, Unix sockets under a new 0700 root
publicHttps: Distinct dynamically allocated loopback ports with generated CA
internalMtls: Distinct loopback ports; never expose to devices
mail: Owned Mailpit instance; synthetic accounts only
secrets: Generated by authdev init into root/material; never copy to Git or artifacts
gate: FROZEN after init; recover is an explicit operator command
rollback: Application binaries only; no down migrations
